Panchayati Raj is a system of rural local governance.

items: The Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) is frequently asked in relation to democratic decentralization.
Rajasthan is repeatedly tested as the first state to implement Panchayati Raj (1959).
Remember that Andhra Pradesh was the second state to implement Panchayati Raj.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Panchayati Raj is a system designed for rural local governance.
The Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) formally recommended democratic decentralization.
Rajasthan became the first state in India to implement Panchayati Raj in 1959.
Andhra Pradesh followed Rajasthan as the second state to adopt the system.
